name: comp-230

frames.best_why: The panel is open with the search field, both organisations, a tick and the New organization row.

tagline: A searchable organisation picker with a create-new row at its foot.
summary: A labelled picker over a couple of organisations, with a search field, a tick on the current one and a New organization action below a divider. Choosing a row closes the panel and fills the trigger.
appearance: A small label sits above a wide rounded trigger reading coss.com with a chevron. Opened, a dark popover holds a search field, two short organisation rows with a tick on the first, a thin divider and a full-width New organization row with a plus.
behaviour: Clicking the trigger opens the panel; typing filters the rows on each keystroke, and choosing one closes it and writes the name into the trigger. The clip types cr and ends on Cruip.
demo_content: coss.com and Cruip organisations with a New organization action; search typed cr
search_phrases: search organisations and add a new one
picker with a create new option
dropdown with an add row at the bottom
searchable select plus a new item
choose an organization from a list
filter a list and create a record
type to find then add new
use_when: When a picker needs a short list and a quick way out to create the item that is missing.
avoid_when: Typing hides the New organization row while filtering, so the create action vanishes exactly when it may be needed.
customise: The two organisations sit in an array in the file; swap them for your own names and values. The action row, its plus icon and the search placeholder are written there too.
weight_why: Two text rows plus one action in a popup with a short open animation.

a11y.note: The trigger is a labelled combobox and filtering works from the keyboard; the New organization row is a plain button, so its keyboard order is unclear.

issues: Typing in the search hides the New organization row, so the create action disappears while filtering.
The field label is the demo phrase Select with search and button, not a real field name.
polish_why: Neat grouped popover with a clear action row; the action vanishing on search is a real snag.
title: Combobox With Action
